content.en: Comprehensive regulatory framework under Plastic Waste Management Rules, 2016 and subsequent notifications banning identified Single-Use Plastics (SUPs) and imposing Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR).
content.hi: Comprehensive regulatory framework under Plastic Waste Management Rules, 2016 and subsequent notifications banning identified Single-Use Plastics (SUPs) and imposing Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR).

content.en:
• Nationwide ban on 19 identified Single-Use Plastic (SUP) items effective from 1 July 2022 (straws, cutlery, ear buds with plastic sticks, thermocol decoration).
• Minimum thickness of plastic carry bags increased to 120 microns (effective 31 Dec 2022).
• Mandatory EPR categories: Rigid plastic packaging (Cat I), Flexible plastic packaging (Cat II), Multi-layered plastic packaging (Cat III), and Plastic sheets/carry bags (Cat IV).
• Microplastics (< 5mm) bioaccumulate across marine food webs, transporting endocrine-disrupting chemicals (BPA, phthalates).
